title: Sleepy zebra
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='65' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#c9c4e8'/>
    <!-- stripes on body -->
    <path d='M30 52 q4 13 0 26' stroke='#4a3f8a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M42 49 q4 16 0 32' stroke='#4a3f8a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M54 48 q4 17 0 34' stroke='#4a3f8a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M66 52 q3 13 0 26' stroke='#4a3f8a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <rect x='30' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a9a3d8'/>
    <rect x='58' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a9a3d8'/>
    <rect x='30' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a3f8a'/>
    <rect x='58' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4a3f8a'/>
    <!-- neck -->
    <path d='M70 58 q12 -14 10 -28' stroke='#c9c4e8' stroke-width='16' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M74 52 q5 -8 4 -18' stroke='#4a3f8a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- mane -->
    <path d='M78 30 q0 -6 6 -8 q2 6 -2 9' fill='#6b5fc4'/>
    <path d='M84 24 q2 -6 8 -6 q0 6 -3 8' fill='#6b5fc4'/>
    <path d='M76 38 q-4 -4 -2 -10 q6 1 5 8' fill='#6b5fc4'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <path d='M80 20 q3 -8 9 -6 q-1 7 -6 9' fill='#b8b1e6'/>
    <path d='M88 22 q5 -6 10 -3 q-3 6 -8 6' fill='#b8b1e6'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='86' cy='32' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#c9c4e8'/>
    <!-- stripes on head -->
    <path d='M82 22 q2 6 0 12' stroke='#4a3f8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M90 22 q1 6 0 13' stroke='#4a3f8a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='36' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#e6e1ff'/>
    <ellipse cx='73' cy='37' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#8a7fd0'/>
    <!-- sleeping eye -->
    <path d='M84 31 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#4a3f8a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- sleepy zzz -->
    <path d='M50 18 h8 l-8 10 h8' stroke='#ffd6a0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <path d='M64 8 h6 l-6 8 h6' stroke='#ffe9c9' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
